name: agentarmy-forge
description: Code generator — function-tier image extracting the middle-core 'modelgen' role into a fleet-wide service. Reads an ontology (RDF/OWL: Turtle / JSON-LD / N-Triples, OR back-compat YAML) from any of three sources — backend-core's /ontology/snapshot HTTP endpoint, a local file, or an Azure Blob URI — and emits typed source files for any combination of frontend-core (TypeScript + Zod schemas), middle-core (C# records + projection interfaces), backend-core (Python Pydantic v2 models), and backend-core/rust-api-v2 (Rust serde structs + state-machine enums). Generated files land in each consumer spoke as a `chore(generated): forge sync` PR against `main` (auto-merge on green CI). Triggered by backend-core webhook (HMAC-verified) on ontology change, OR on demand via CLI + the fleet MCP control plane. v0+v1+v2 emit source only; binary builds + deployment stay with consumer CI and `deployment-engineer`. Governing decision: ARC-ADR-029.

shims.note: rdflib parses Turtle / JSON-LD / N-Triples (the forge-specific OWL vocabulary documented in scripts/forge/parsers/rdf_parser.py). pyshacl is loaded by the v1 ingest-validate path. azure-storage-blob + azure-identity for managed-identity blob input. nodejs + typescript + zod let the doctor smoke-compile the v2 TS emit. .NET SDK is deliberately NOT baked in (~400MB) — the C# emit is proven via the byte-identical golden check; dotnet smoke-build is opt-in via SKIP_DOTNET=0.

baked.purpose: Dispatches on MODE env: serve | generate | ingest-validate | doctor.

FastAPI app: POST /webhook (HMAC-verified per ARC-ADR-029 Open Question 1 — constant-time compare via hmac.compare_digest, lifted from hmac-verify-image) triggers a generate cycle; POST /generate accepts an on-demand request body; GET /healthz + /readyz + /livez match contracts/health.openapi.yaml.

CLI mode: `forge generate --source <http|file|blob> --target <csharp|typescript|python|all> --out <dir> [--consumer-repo owner/repo]`. Shared library entrypoint that the HTTP /generate handler also calls.

Intermediate Representation — frozen dataclasses (Model / ObjectType / Field / Relation) that parsers fill and emitters consume. Includes IR validate() that runs before any emit (allowed scalars, cardinalities, target references, name uniqueness).

Input parsers: yaml_parser (back-compat for middle-core model.yaml shape) and rdf_parser (forge-specific OWL vocabulary over Turtle / JSON-LD / N-Triples — fieldOrder/relationOrder lists keep emit deterministic).

Input adapters: http_source (backend-core /ontology/snapshot with conditional GET via If-None-Match), file_source (local file:// or absolute paths), blob_source (Azure Blob URI with connection-string OR DefaultAzureCredential / managed identity).

Language adapters: csharp.py (v0 — records + I{Name}Projection interfaces + DataPlatformContracts.g.cs), typescript.py (v2 — interfaces + Zod schemas, data-platform-contracts.g.ts), python.py (v2 — Pydantic v2 models with forward refs, data_platform_contracts.g.py), rust.py (#305 — serde structs + {Name}State enums with kebab-case rename, data_platform_contracts.g.rs), sql.py (#386 — per-object backend SELECTs from the bindings facet via EMITTERS[postgres|arcadedb], NOT a CLI target; consumed by a spoke's gen_data_objects.py → generated_bindings.rs). All deterministic: no timestamps, sorted dict keys, LF line endings.

Clones a consumer spoke, applies generated files, opens a PR titled `chore(generated): forge sync — ontology@<sha>` with auto-merge enabled. Supports `local:<bare-repo-path>` for the doctor + `owner/repo` for real GitHub usage. Dry-run via FORGE_DRY_RUN=1 logs the would-be `gh` call.

Doctor proves: readiness; ontology fetch from each source (http/file/blob — blob skip-with-PASS in CI per SKIP_AZURE=1); v0 C# emit byte-identical to the frozen golden (tests/golden/reference.g.cs); smoke-compile passes (tsc --noEmit on TS, importlib check on Python; dotnet skipped by default); pr_opener opens against a dummy bare local repo.
Frozen golden fixtures: reference.model.yaml (input), reference.g.cs / .g.ts / .g.py (expected outputs), reference.ttl (RDF input the doctor's http-source check serves).

doctor.description: /healthz 200; ontology fetches return parseable RDF from each source (blob = SKIP-with-PASS in CI when SKIP_AZURE=1, _parse_uri unit-checked); v0 C# emit byte-identical to the frozen golden reference.g.cs AND Rust emit byte-identical to reference.g.rs; smoke-compile of the generated TS via `tsc --noEmit` + Python via importlib (C# smoke-build SKIP-with-PASS by default — set SKIP_DOTNET=0 + bake dotnet SDK to enable); pr_opener pushes the generated file to a doctor-initialised bare local repo on a `forge/doctor-test` branch.

deploy.notes: Function-tier per ARC-ADR-029 / ARC-ADR-023. Different scale curve from middle-core runtime (bursty generation vs steady request rate); different toolchain (python + nodejs in one image — .NET SDK opt-in via Dockerfile layering); different release cadence (generator improvements ship independently of any spoke's runtime). Co-locate near backend-core so the /ontology/snapshot HTTP fetch is intra-region.

contract.note: Backlog row authored alongside this scaffold: POST /webhook (HMAC), POST /generate, GET /healthz/livez/readyz. Promote to Registry when published+mocked in Postman.
